title: Discriminative Kalman Filter Formalized
summary: Asymptotic correctness of the discriminative Kalman filter for a stationary linear Gaussian state model with nonlinear and non-Gaussian observations. Formalizes Appendix B, Theorem 2, Lemma 1, and Remarks 1–4 of Burkhart et al. (2020): weak convergence, eventual Gaussian well-definedness, L1 consistency, the exact Gaussian parameter update, the robust update, and the extension to random input distributions with convergence in probability.

formalizes.title: The Discriminative Kalman Filter for Bayesian Filtering with Nonlinear and Nongaussian Observation Models

review.reason: Formalizes asymptotic correctness of the discriminative Kalman filter under nonlinear observations.
